summary: Operator site read: 30/50-amp sites with water and sewer, showers, laundry, free Wi-Fi, heated pool. Fees left as recorded ($49.05 daily, read 2026-10-10): the rates page carries no date, and a second table on it shows $24/$26 nightly, so the page cannot confirm a 2024+ rate. Note trimmed of rates/Good Sam and now says what the park mostly is. Not stated: site count, rig length, booking method beyond phone.
flags: Long-stay test 5 (home community / sells homes) fails: the operator's own site has a 'Park Model for Sale, just reduced: $19,999' page (https://orangeblossomrvpark.com/park_model.php), alongside year-round ($375/month), 6-month seasonal ('Live in, any 6 months and store trailer 6 months') and monthly rates, lot fruit trees and county-permitted sheds/carports/rooms (park rules). Per AWH 2026-10-21 (Ridge Manor 14409: ambiguous 'units for sale' = drop), this looks like a drop.

Price gate: posted daily rate $49.05 for 2 people, just under US$50, with $1/night per extra adult and $1/night for A/C; the page is undated, and a second 'CAMPING RATES' table on the same page lists 30-amp $24 / 50-amp $26 nightly, so the current nightly price is unclear. No gateway within 40 km (nearest Tampa 73 km); the family has not stayed here.

Name: the operator's site calls itself 'Orange Blossom RV Park and Storage'; it does not say 'Adult RV Park' on the pages read, and its rules mention visiting children with adult supervision, so the adults-only line could not be confirmed.
The site's header links michcamping.com (a Michigan camping directory), which looks like a template leftover; the domain itself is the park's.
